templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing two parties to share confidential information in connection with a business relationship. Covers use and protection of confidential information, exceptions, term, and governing law. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, containing customizable fields for purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, and party signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Covers service access and use, restrictions, privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for early product access in exchange for structured feedback, allowing a provider to develop and improve a product. Covers product access, feedback program participation, IP ownership of feedback, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard SLA defining uptime and response time commitments for cloud services, including service credit calculation, requesting credits, and termination rights for sustained failures. Designed for use alongside the Common Paper CSA.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for professional services engagements with deliverables. Covers SOW-based services, IP assignment of deliverables, change orders, subcontractors, payment, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Standard GDPR-compliant data processing agreement covering processor and subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, international data transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, audit rights, and data deletion.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for licensing on-premise software. Covers installation license, restrictions, open source software, updates, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard agreement for business partnerships covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing and brand guidelines, payment, privacy, escalation procedures, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard short-term evaluation agreement allowing a prospective customer to test a product before committing to a longer-term commercial deal. Covers pilot access, restrictions, disclaimer of warranties, limited liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Standard HIPAA Business Associate Agreement covering PHI handling obligations, safeguards, subcontractor requirements, individual rights requests, breach notification, and data return or destruction upon termination.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Standard addendum for agreements involving AI services, covering permitted AI usage, model training restrictions, IP ownership of AI outputs, personal data protections, and disclaimers about the nature of AI-generated content.
